spanish: Y a sacrificio de los pazes: ganado dos, carneros cinco, chivos cinco, corderos hijos de año cinco; esta ofrenda de Shelumiél hijo de Tsurishadai.

findings.issue: «pazes» is not the Spanish plural of paz, so the definite plural noun is only partly legible as that peace term.
זֶה is masculine singular, agreeing with masculine קרבן; «esta» is feminine so it matches Spanish «ofrenda». Grammatical smoothing; the referent is unchanged.

notes: Conjunction, ל, constructs, counts, and plurals match the tokens; Shelumiél and Tsurishadai are not locked in PROPER_NAMES.md.
